```{.python .input} %%tab jax @d2l.add_to_class(d2l.Classifier) #@save @partial(jax.jit, static_argnums=(0, 5)) def loss(self, params, X, Y, state, averaged=True): # To be used later (e.g., for batch norm) Y_hat = state.apply_fn({'params': params}, *X, mutable=False, rngs=None) Y_hat = d2l.reshape(Y_hat, (-1, Y_hat.shape[-1])) Y = d2l.reshape(Y, (-1,)) fn = optax.softmax_cross_entropy_with_integer_labels # The returned empty dictionary is a placeholder for auxiliary data, # which will be used later (e.g., for batch norm) return (fn(Y_hat, Y).mean(), {}) if averaged else (fn(Y_hat, Y), {}) ```
